segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: Thank you. Good afternoon, our distinguished budget sponsor, Honorable Senator Erwin Tulfo, to Chairperson of Civil Service Marilyn Barua Yap, Chairperson Urduja Alvarado.

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: Ladies and gentlemen, good afternoon. I am pleased to present the proposed budget of the Career Executive Service Board for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: Our proposed budget will support the CES Board in delivering and fulfilling its unique mandate enshrined in Presidential Decree No. 1 to promulgate rules, standard procedures in the selection, classification, compensation, and career development of the members of the CES.

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: It is noteworthy that our mandate covers the four pillars of the human resource management in the third level.

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: Our budget is aligned with the Philippine Development Plan 2023 to 2028.

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: Under Chapter 14, Outcome 4, where competent, motivated, resilient public servants are supported, it specifically provides that the CES system will be strengthened through merit and fitness, where the potential and qualified third-level officials will undergo the four-stage CES eligibility examination process, the CES leadership management proficiency program, and other lifelong learning programs for appointment to CES

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: rank to build up a critical mass of CES officers and eligibles. It complements our mission to infuse the bureaucracy with well-selected and development-oriented leaders, [unclear] bring change, expertise and leadership for responsive public service. Under our PREXC, the CESB operations is focused on the core program of career executive screening and development to ensure and promote merit and fitness for entry to the CES and sustaining a continuing pool of CES

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: eligibles and CESOs. Our proposed budget for 2027 in summary, originally we proposed 219 million but we were only provided with 142.857 million under the National Expenditure Program. Our 2027 budget per NEP consists only of personnel services

segments.speaker: CESB Executive Director Maria Marcy Cosare-Ballesteros
segments.text: and MOOE without capital outlay. This NEP, our budget in the NEP, represents an increase of 34% from our previous 2026 budget due to the 58% increase in MOOE and 8% increase in personnel services. segments.text: Siguro, Secdita, what, what, what else are we doing so that we can improve our arrivals?

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: Again, sir, we would like to highlight those other products na alam naming may pool, katulad po ng gastronomy, tourism po.

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: Kasi po, dumaki po ang transaction, both volume and value among those that have been recognized by Michelin po.

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: And then, you're correct, sir, about the restaurants.

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: than other maybe Asian countries pagdating sa cost of food and services.

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: Pero sa food poster, it's a, I think, logistical issue.

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: It's, you know, we have to have better cold chain facility,

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: better roads, et cetera, to transport the items and produce in real time.

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: So I think that's something that we can work on together

segments.speaker: DOT Secretary Dita Angara-Mathay
segments.text: with Department of Transportation and Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Just quickly, Mr. Chair, with your permission,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: there's a proposal to scrap travel tax, to ease travel costs.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But I just want to ask TESA if there are concrete revenue alternatives

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: presented to ensure it doesn't keep asking Congress directly

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: kasi mawawala yung sa inyo yan, ano?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Directly, kung mawawala ang travel tax, it will affect TESA,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sige, si GM, Dr. Mark Labid.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: With the permission of our Secretary,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yes, regarding the issue of travel tax,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: definitely we will be deeply affected

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: because 94% to 95% of our operation is coming from travel tax.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: As a matter of fact, for 2027, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: we already, as early as March,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: we already submitted our proposed budget to DBM

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: since there's already a pending abolition of travel tax.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: But I think in June, Mr. Chair, we received a letter coming from DBM

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: stating that they gave us zero budget allocation in the NEP.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So with that, Mr. Chair, wala akong binigay na item sa amin

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: or zero budget ang binigay sa amin ng DBM.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So what we did, we immediately revert muna.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: to our board and submitted our corporate operating budget

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Because as I mentioned a while ago,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: we are heavily relying on the collection of travel tax,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: which is around 4.03 billion for the CHESA share.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: And the half of that is going to CHED and NCCA, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And the majority goes to CHESA.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So on a nutshell, Mr. Chair, gusto natin may alamin ni Senator Tulfo,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: ano-ano ba yung mga projects that, of course, yung mga infrastructure projects,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but what will, ano pa yung mga main?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Of course, yung mga, ano yan, di ba, yung mga lounge, mga comfort rooms.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Sir, not only that, yung mga vital projects po namin ngayon,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: like yung water problem ng El Nido, we're addressing it.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Coron, we're the one who's doing the STP also.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: And then we're also the one who's rehabilitating the 10 domestic airports that we have, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: that was submitted to us by CAAP.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Not to mention the hotels, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: That's how you are also operating.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Banawe, including the rehabilitation of Club Intramuros Golf Course also, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So ito po yung mga nasa pipeline namin.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: We have at least four, Mr. Chair, na hotels.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: And then the other one is Gardens of Malasag, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So yan po yung mga areas namin na inaayos as of now.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: But aside from this one, sir, we're also supporting the LGUs from other projects,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: like as I mentioned a while ago, the rehabilitation of Burham Park sa Burakay,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: pa rin po kami sa Siargao, we're also part on the rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So yun lang po ang amin na different tourist facilities ang aming binibuilt,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: which is more on vertical, including on the PCSSD, on the dive tourism, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: We're also providing the hyperbaric chamber sa mga different dive destinations po natin.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So these were all being funded by the travel tax, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: So what is your request, Dr. Lapid?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Na po pwede ituloy muna hanggang December yung pagkukulek ng travel tax?

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Sir, we humbly request to your honor, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: baka pwede po munang magkaroon tayo ng transition period for the travel tax.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: We don't object with any denotion of the abolishment, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: but as of now, with the current fiscal situation, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: medyo may hirapan ho ang ahensya namin, not only us,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: the tourism industry, when it comes to the infrastructure support,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: e baka magkaroon po, sir, ng konting consideration to expand it for the meantime.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Since for 2027, sir, we don't have any budget that was given to us.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So how are the obligated projects na ginagawa ho namin?

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: How are we going to continue and sustain?

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: Plus the other in our pipeline, paano ho yan, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: which we're also asking DBM about that question.

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: So in the meantime, sir, kung habang wala,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: kung wala pong pera ang national government,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: we humbly seek na requesting na baka pwede magkaroon muna po ng extension for the meantime,

segments.speaker: TIEZA COO Mark T. Lapid
segments.text: habang wala pong pera na pang-replace dun sa travel tax, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: That's the reason why I invited DBM.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi na sumipot. Natakot siguro. Baka walang masagot.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Baka nahihina sa pantalon yung tao na yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: But anyway, sige po, we're looking to this.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We understand where you're coming from.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Pag nasa pipeline na yung project, anong gagawin? Hindi na po pondohan.

segments.text: Pero kailangan, we have to sit down with DBM.

segments.text: Pag nakita ko ho yung bukas.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Thank you. Good afternoon, Mr. Chair and distinguished members of the committee.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Allow me to present the, for year 2027, proposed corporate operating budget of Duty Free Philippines Corporation.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: DFPC is a government corporation mandated to operate duty and tax-free merchandising system to serve tourists and returning Filipino travelers, generate foreign exchange, and contribute revenues to the government.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Our for year 2027 program is anchored on fulfilling this mandate while strengthening DFPC's sustainability.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: With its existing 18 stores strategically located in international gateways.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: So, for year 2027, DFPC proposes total sources of funds of 3.134 billion, of which 2.808 billion is internally generated revenue.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Our total program uses amount to approximately 2.996 billion primarily for MOOE, capital investments,

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: The capitalization will support strategic investments intended to strengthen DFPC revenue generating capacity.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Sales declined significantly during the pandemic, reaching a low of approximately $35 million in 2021.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: If you've noticed, sales recovered to $103 million in 2023, but declined to $82 million in 2025.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: As of August 2026, sales stand at approximately $45.7 million.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: And the main contributors to the decrease in sales primarily change in retail landscape, customer buying behavior, competition, high operating costs and airport concession fees, and of course, currency exchange volatility.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: These figures highlight the need to strengthen our retail operations and extend our revenue base.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Despite these challenges, we would like to...

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: We would like to highlight DFPC's total remittances to the Department of Tourism, total of 10.401 billion, reflecting the corporate sustained contribution to the tourism sector.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: So that's about 250 million pesos a year.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: This is in relation to the proposed expansion budget of 326 million under...

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: For year 2027 NEP, this is intended to fund the development and expansion of DFPC's retail operations at key international gateways, particularly NAIA Terminals 1 and 3.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: This will increase revenue generating capacity, improve service to international travelers, and provide additional market access for filament-made products.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: This is in support of the Department of Tourism program to promote and strengthen local products and Filipino brands.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: So, in summary, DFPC's for year 2027 proposal is focused on financial sustainability, strategic investments, comment

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Our objective is to strengthen sales,

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: maximize the use of government resources,

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: the FPC's contribution to the government.

segments.speaker: DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
DFPC COO Patrick Joel M. Cinco
segments.text: Thank you for that question, Mr. Chair.

NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: The Nayong Pilipino Foundation is focused on establishing a cultural hub that inspires Filipino creativity, green spaces, and sustainable park operation, in addition to supporting the Philippine tourism industry through research, development, and training.

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: Pending the development of the Nayong Pilipino Cultural Park, which is currently under review, we are at the helm of dissemination of our programs on Macanayon, Filipinization,

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: and soon our festival management program.

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: We have trained 1,246 persons from 17 regions from various schools and LGUs.

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: We have 3,000 artifacts for our museum,

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: which we have displayed at the Clark Expo site in Pampanga for 14 years from 2007 to 2021

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: and at the Tarlac Provincial Museum for the past three years, 2023 to 2026.

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: We now have select artifacts on display at the Ayala Museum,

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: the Talikang Pilipino Gallery II, the National Museum in Iloilo, and the National Museum in Zamboanga.

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: Our current space, while awaiting our park development program,

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: is currently maintaining a bike trail of 3 kilometers,

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
segments.text: an arboretum with 3,000 native trees developed with the Energy Development Corporation,

segments.speaker: NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
NPF Executive Director Leonila R. Fabul
